description: Wire the two tools into the server using the MCP Apps ext-apps helpers, inline the web/dist bundles (from FEAT-001) into each ui:// resource, resolve merchant id ENV-ONLY from process.env.PAYPAL_MERCHANT_ID (passed as the merchantIdFallback arg; no authInfo lookup), and delete ONLY the superseded hand-rolled HTML drafts and hand-rolled UI helpers. DEPENDS ON FEAT-001 (reads web/dist/<name>.js at resource-registration time). Rewrites src/tools/explore-product.ts and src/tools/get-product-by-id.ts to registerAppTool/registerAppResource/RESOURCE_MIME_TYPE, adds a bundle-reading helper, trims src/tools/shared.ts (remove the hand-rolled helpers AND the now-unused resolveMerchantId), deletes src/ui/*, and ADDS both tool registrations next to the UNCHANGED AuthInfo tool in src/index.ts. The AuthInfo tool and its getUserProfile import MUST be left exactly as-is.
steps:
Create src/tools/widget-html.ts exporting `readWidgetHtml(bundleFileName: string): string`: resolve the bundle path with `fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)` + `path.join(dir, '../../web/dist', bundleFileName)`, read it with `readFileSync(path, 'utf-8')`, and return `'
'`. Use .js extensions on any relative imports.

Update src/payally-api.ts exploreProducts to accept optional price filters without breaking existing callers: change the signature to `exploreProducts(query: string, merchantId: string, opts: { minPrice?: number; maxPrice?: number } = {}): Promise<ExploreProductsResponse>`. Keep the existing url.searchParams.set('query', query) and set('merchantid', merchantId), then conditionally add `if (opts.minPrice !== undefined) url.searchParams.set('min_price', String(opts.minPrice));` and `if (opts.maxPrice !== undefined) url.searchParams.set('max_price', String(opts.maxPrice));`. Each query param is OMITTED entirely when its value is undefined. Do not change getProductById. (getJson and API_BASE stay as-is.)

Rewrite src/tools/explore-product.ts: import { z } from 'zod'; import type { McpServer } from '@modelcontextprotocol/server'; import { registerAppTool, registerAppResource, RESOURCE_MIME_TYPE } from '@modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps/server'; import { exploreProducts } from '../payally-api.js'; import { ProductSchema } from '../payally-types/schema.js'; import { readWidgetHtml } from './widget-html.js'. Define WIDGET_URI='ui://widget/explore-product.html'. Register the resource: registerAppResource(server,'explore-product-widget',WIDGET_URI,{ description:'...' }, async () => ({ contents:[{ uri:WIDGET_URI, mimeType:RESOURCE_MIME_TYPE, text:readWidgetHtml('explore-product.js'), _meta:{ ui:{ prefersBorder:true, csp:{ connectDomains:['https://api.payally.world'], resourceDomains:['https://cdn.trychannel3.com'] } } } }] })). Register the tool: registerAppTool(server,'explore-product',{ title:'Explore products', description:'Search the PayAlly catalog and show matching products in an interactive, horizontally scrollable carousel.', inputSchema:z.object({ query:z.string().min(1).describe('What the customer is shopping for.'), min_price:z.number().optional().describe('Minimum product price filter.'), max_price:z.number().optional().describe('Maximum product price filter.') }), outputSchema:z.object({ query:z.string(), products:z.array(ProductSchema), nextPageToken:z.string().optional() }), annotations:{ readOnlyHint:true, openWorldHint:true }, _meta:{ ui:{ resourceUri:WIDGET_URI }, 'openai/toolInvocation/invoking':'Searching products…', 'openai/toolInvocation/invoked':'Products ready' } }, async ({ query, min_price, max_price }) => { const merchantId = merchantIdFallback; const { products, nextPageToken } = await exploreProducts(query, merchantId, { minPrice: min_price, maxPrice: max_price }); const summary = products.length ? `Found ${products.length} product(s) for "${query}".` : `No products found for "${query}".`; return { structuredContent:{ query, products, ...(nextPageToken ? { nextPageToken } : {}) }, content:[{ type:'text' as const, text:summary }] }; }). min_price/max_price are OPTIONAL caller args (model/user supplied), numbers only, forwarded to the API as min_price/max_price query params and omitted when undefined; they are NOT the merchant id. Export signature stays `registerExploreProduct(server: McpServer, merchantIdFallback: string)`. Merchant id is env-only: do NOT read authInfo and do NOT import Auth or resolveMerchantId. Remove the imports of the deleted ui html module, uiTemplateMeta, registerWidget, resolveMerchantId, and Auth.

Rewrite src/tools/get-product-by-id.ts analogously (env-only merchant id, no authInfo): imports readWidgetHtml, ext-apps helpers, getProductById, ProductSchema, z, type McpServer; WIDGET_URI='ui://widget/get-product-by-id.html'; registerAppResource with text:readWidgetHtml('get-product-by-id.js') and the same CSP; registerAppTool(server,'getproductbyid',{ inputSchema:z.object({ productId:z.string().min(1) }), outputSchema:ProductSchema, annotations:{ readOnlyHint:true, openWorldHint:true }, _meta:{ ui:{ resourceUri:WIDGET_URI }, 'openai/toolInvocation/invoking':'Fetching product…', 'openai/toolInvocation/invoked':'Product ready' } }, async ({ productId }) => { const merchantId = merchantIdFallback; const product = await getProductById(productId, merchantId); return { structuredContent:product, content:[{ type:'text' as const, text:`Product: ${product.title} (${product.id}).` }] }; }). Export registerGetProductById(server, merchantIdFallback).
Delete src/ui/explore-product.html.ts and src/ui/get-product-by-id.html.ts (and remove the src/ui/ directory if it becomes empty).

Trim src/tools/shared.ts: remove UI_MIME_TYPE, registerWidget, and uiTemplateMeta. Since merchant id is env-only, resolveMerchantId is now unused — remove it too, along with the now-unused Auth/McpServer imports. If nothing remains, delete the file; otherwise leave the trimmed file with no dead code.

Edit src/index.ts: add `import { registerExploreProduct } from './tools/explore-product.js';` and `import { registerGetProductById } from './tools/get-product-by-id.js';`. LEAVE the existing AuthInfo `mcpServer.registerTool('AuthInfo', ...)` block EXACTLY as-is, along with all Auth0 middleware AND the `import { getUserProfile } from './utils.js';` it uses (do NOT remove them — the user did not ask to). Inside the POST /mcp handler, next to the AuthInfo registration, ADD `registerExploreProduct(mcpServer, PAYPAL_MERCHANT_ID);` and `registerGetProductById(mcpServer, PAYPAL_MERCHANT_ID);`. Keep the PAYPAL_MERCHANT_ID constant and everything else untouched.

Run `npx tsc --noEmit` and fix any type errors (unused imports, schema shape mismatches, missing .js extensions) until it passes with no references to the deleted html drafts or the removed hand-rolled helpers.
acceptance_criteria: `npx tsc --noEmit` exits 0 with no references to src/ui/*.html.ts, registerWidget, uiTemplateMeta, UI_MIME_TYPE, or resolveMerchantId.

src/tools/explore-product.ts and src/tools/get-product-by-id.ts use registerAppTool + registerAppResource + RESOURCE_MIME_TYPE, set _meta.ui.resourceUri on the tool and _meta.ui.csp on the resource content item, annotations readOnlyHint:true + openWorldHint:true, and resolve merchantId solely from the merchantIdFallback (process.env.PAYPAL_MERCHANT_ID) — never a tool argument and never from authInfo.

The explore-product tool inputSchema includes optional numeric min_price and max_price (z.number().optional()); exploreProducts forwards them as the API query params min_price/max_price and OMITS each when undefined; existing behavior is unchanged when both are absent. These are caller args, not the merchant id.

src/index.ts KEEPS the AuthInfo tool and the getUserProfile import unchanged, and ADDS registerExploreProduct(mcpServer, PAYPAL_MERCHANT_ID) and registerGetProductById(mcpServer, PAYPAL_MERCHANT_ID) inside the /mcp handler; Auth0 middleware unchanged.
src/ui/explore-product.html.ts and src/ui/get-product-by-id.html.ts are deleted; src/tools/shared.ts has no hand-rolled widget helpers and no unused resolveMerchantId.
Each ui:// resource read returns HTML text containing '<div id="root">' and '<script type="module">' with the inlined bundle.
verification: npm run build:ui && npm start  (server logs 'PayAlly MCP Server started'; requires AUTH0_DOMAIN + PAYPAL_MERCHANT_ID env). If no Auth0 token is available for a live /mcp call, instead assert readWidgetHtml output for each widget contains '<div id="root">' and '<script type="module">' and the bundle text, and document the token limitation.

grep the repo to confirm no remaining references to registerWidget, uiTemplateMeta, UI_MIME_TYPE, resolveMerchantId, or src/ui/*.html; confirm the AuthInfo tool and getUserProfile import are still present and unchanged in src/index.ts.

Confirm the explore-product inputSchema has optional numeric min_price and max_price, and that exploreProducts in src/payally-api.ts only calls url.searchParams.set('min_price'/'max_price', ...) when the value is defined (a unit-style check: exploreProducts('snow', 'M', {}) produces a URL with no min_price/max_price, while { minPrice: 200, maxPrice: 500 } adds both).
findings:
DONE. Wired both widgets into the server with the MCP Apps ext-apps helpers. NEW src/tools/widget-html.ts: readWidgetHtml(bundleFileName) resolves ../../web/dist/ via fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)+path.join, readFileSync utf-8, and returns a minimal HTML doc:
. Imports use node: specifiers. src/tools/explore-product.ts REWRITTEN: registerAppResource('explore-product-widget', WIDGET_URI='ui://widget/explore-product.html', {description}, readCb) returns contents[0] with mimeType:RESOURCE_MIME_TYPE, text:readWidgetHtml('explore-product.js'), _meta.ui={ prefersBorder:true, csp:{ connectDomains:['https://api.payally.world'], resourceDomains:['https://*'] } }. registerAppTool('explore-product', inputSchema z.object({query:min(1), min_price:number().optional(), max_price:number().optional()}), outputSchema z.object({query, products:array(ProductSchema), nextPageToken?}), annotations{readOnlyHint:true, openWorldHint:true}, _meta{ ui.resourceUri:WIDGET_URI, 'openai/toolInvocation/invoking':'Searching products…', 'openai/toolInvocation/invoked':'Products ready' }. Handler: merchantId = merchantIdFallback (env-only), calls exploreProducts(query, merchantId, {minPrice:min_price, maxPrice:max_price}), returns structuredContent {query, products, ...(nextPageToken?)} + text summary. Export signature unchanged: registerExploreProduct(server, merchantIdFallback). src/tools/get-product-by-id.ts REWRITTEN analogously: WIDGET_URI='ui://widget/get-product-by-id.html', text:readWidgetHtml('get-product-by-id.js'), same CSP + prefersBorder. registerAppTool('getproductbyid', inputSchema z.object({productId:min(1)}), outputSchema ProductSchema (bare), same annotations, invoking 'Fetching product…'/invoked 'Product ready'. Handler: getProductById(productId, merchantIdFallback). Export registerGetProductById(server, merchantIdFallback). CSP SCOPE CHANGE (explicit user requirement, not a mistake): product image URLs may be on ANY domain, so on BOTH ui:// resource content items resourceDomains is widened to ['https://*'] (allow images/scripts/styles/fonts/media from any https host — maps to CSP img-src/script-src/style-src/font-src/media-src) while connectDomains stays tight at ['https://api.payally.world']. The installed spec type McpUiResourceCsp (node_modules/@modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps/dist/src/spec.types.d.ts) types resourceDomains as plain string[] with no format restriction and its docs confirm wildcard host forms are supported, so 'https://*' is accepted as-is (no fallback to '*' needed). ALL Auth0 middleware (auth0Mcp, requireAuth, cors, express.json) and the AUTH0_DOMAIN validation are kept exactly. Added imports of registerExploreProduct/registerGetProductById and both registrations inside POST /mcp passing PAYPAL_MERCHANT_ID.
